meta.title: Send your fresh fish requirements
meta.description: Send your fish requirements to AZAFCO International: species, weight grade, packing, quantity, destination and Incoterm, by email or WhatsApp.

hero.title: Send your requirements
hero.intro: Open a prepared message, fill in the blank lines and send it from your company email or business WhatsApp. That lets us confirm who is asking; our emails always come from the azafco.com.eg domain.

short_hero.corporate_intro: For partnerships, investment or other business topics. Write from your company email; no product details needed.
short_hero.documents_intro: Ask from your company email for product specifications or the company profile.

aside.title: What happens after you write to us
steps: The export team reviews your requirements against the specification and current availability.
We confirm price, quantity, packing and terms with you in writing.
aside.no_promise: Sending your requirements does not commit you or us to an order.
prepare: Quantity per shipment and how often
Air or road freight, and arrival airport or border crossing

switch.to_corporate: For partnerships, investment or other topics: <link>Send a corporate enquiry</link>
switch.to_seafood: Looking to buy fish? <link>Send your requirements instead</link>

request.title: Your message, ready to send
request.title_documents: Your document request, ready to send
request.intro: Choose a channel. Each button opens a prepared message: complete the blank lines, then send it.
request.summary_title: Already filled in from the page you came from
request.summary_note: You can change any line in the message before you send it.
request.attach_note: If you have a specification or packing sheet, attach it to the email.
request.fallback_title: If your email app does not open
request.fallback_text: Write from your company email to this address and use this subject line and message.
